channel.title: Plain Words
channel.description: Every metric, benchmark and adjustment a runner meets on a watch, explained with numbers, methods and sources. No ads, no affiliates, nothing gated.

item.title: Is a sub-4 marathon realistic? A five-input reality check
item.description: Sub-4 needs 5:41/km (9:09/mi). Five inputs decide whether that is yours: half time, weekly volume, longest run, course and heat.

item.title: What Strava's Fitness score actually measures
item.description: It is a 42-day average of training load, not fitness. That is why it can fall by 10 points in the block where you got faster.

item.title: Why your watch and your app predict different race times
item.description: One reads your training, the other reads one race. From a 25:00 5K, 3 published models already disagree by 6 minutes at marathon distance.
